q.en: Choose the correct option: She ___ to school every day.
q.as: শুদ্ধ বিকল্পটো বাছনি কৰক: She ___ to school every day.

explanation.en: In the simple present tense a third-person singular subject (She) takes the verb form 'goes'.
explanation.as: Simple present tense ত তৃতীয় পুৰুষ একবচন কৰ্তা (She) ৰ সৈতে 'goes' ৰূপ ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।
